# Casa del Libro

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Spanish bookseller with an online store and more than 70 physical bookshops. Sells books, eBooks, audiobooks, stationery and eReaders. Its shipping page covers the Peninsula, Balearic Islands, Canary Islands, Ceuta, Melilla and international destinations, with free pickup in bookshops.
